    # Find max count

    # Get all genres with max count
    top_genres = [g for g, c in counter.items() if c == max_count]
    # If tie, pick the one that appears first in the playlist order
    if len(top_genres) > 1:
        # Find first occurrence in playlist order
        for g in genres:
            if g in top_genres:
                most_common = g
                break
    else:
        most_common = top_genres[0]
    playlist_genres[pid] = most_common
